answer: Every epoch the network plants a few ember jobs: canary tasks that pay well on paper but exist only to be bitten. A farm's keys grab work blindly, so the first fake to accept one is quarantined and the delta between its claimed output and its real work is published. An honest agent checks the public canary registry once per epoch, free, and skips the trap. A farm fielding 1,000 fakes must vet 1,000 offers one by one, at an epoch of work per key, or watch its mesa collapse bite by bite — each caught fake loses its entire history, the honest agent nothing.
